title: Bounded finite-lisse prime-field complexes have etale perfect models
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $T$ a scheme, $\lambda=\mathbf F_\ell$, and $C\in D(T_{et},\lambda)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Suppose $H^i(C)=0$ outside a finite interval and all $H^i(C)$ are finite locally constant [def-constructible-finite-locally-constant]. Then there is an etale covering $\{U_j\to T\}$ such that each $C|_{U_j}$ is isomorphic to a bounded complex $P_j$ of coefficient sheaves whose every term is a retract of the constant sheaf associated to $\lambda^{m}$ for some finite $m$ depending on the term. Equivalently $C$ satisfies the ordinary etale predicate AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.DerivedCategory.IsSitePerfect; the covering, boundedness and retract data are precisely the data just displayed. No invertibility of $\ell$ on $T$ is needed.

source.place: Local finite-free calculation and bounded truncation, made precise using Stacks sites-cohomology.tex lemma-locally-constant (094G).

proof.text: Apply the local-model clause of [lem-weil-pbc-finite-ring-derived-local-constancy] with the finite ring F_ell. It gives an etale covering and bounded complexes of finite modules representing the exact derived restrictions of C. The ordered bound hypothesis implies the weaker unordered-bound hypothesis of that theorem.

Every finite module over F_ell has a finite vector-space basis. Apply the constant-sheaf functor to the basis coordinate isomorphism E^n ≅ F_ell^(Fin m). Its hom and inverse give the two retract arrows, and their composite is the identity by functoriality. The constant-sheaf functor carries each zero term outside the bounds to zero, giving the strict support conditions.

The comparison between left-derived inverse image and the derived functor of exact inverse image turns the local-model isomorphism into the left-derived-pullback isomorphism in IsSitePerfect. Thus all fields of that predicate are supplied. Rank zero and an empty covering of the empty scheme cause no exception.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteLisseField_sitePerfect (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (T : Scheme.{u})
    (C : DerivedCategoryModule (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ)) T)
    (hbounded : ∃ a b : ℤ, a ≤ b ∧ ∀ i : ℤ, (i < a ∨ b < i) →
      IsZero ((_root_.DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ i).obj C))
    (hlisse : ∀ i : ℤ, Scheme.IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf
      ((_root_.DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ i).obj C)) :
    DerivedCategory.IsSitePerfect C
